disclosure: Six hand-specified models; results follow from stipulated assumptions. No optimizing agent, human study, fitted parameters, novelty search or field prevalence claim.

models.name: Instant stop, missing participation channel
models.interpretation: A channel viability threshold follows from the assumed fixed-cost rule. It is not an estimated social critical fraction. Rebuilding time, not token revocation latency, binds the exit horizon.
models.counterexample: A funded public channel, immediate replacement, or rebuild_time <= exit_horizon removes this construction.

models.name: Locally rational grants, jointly unwanted tempo
models.interpretation: Delegation is strictly individually beneficial at either fixed background, yet the joint low-delegation state Pareto-dominates the high state. This is ordinary collective-action mathematics; any eventual residue must be the authority-producing adaptation and a different measurement/intervention.
models.counterexample: If the shared tempo cost is less than private benefit, the all-delegate state is not jointly unwanted.

models.name: Recognition is not provider count
models.interpretation: Reachability and graph cuts are inherited machinery. The proposed outcome is continuation of particular legitimate relationships under issuer loss, not general authority or welfare.
models.counterexample: If counterparties accept user-signed substitutes without issuer guarantees, the bottleneck disappears.

models.name: Success-only transfer cannot identify an unobserved constraint
assumptions: Identical complete performed-action histories are the only input
A never-performed new action is required where allowed
No constraint violations permitted in either world
models.interpretation: No deterministic decision can both act usefully in the permissive world and avoid the action in the constrained world. Randomization cannot guarantee both. This is a generic indistinguishability argument, not a new theorem about AI.
models.counterexample: Independent constraint evidence, informative abstention reasons, consultation, or allowing safe abstention defeats the triangle.

models.name: Same revoked permissions, unequal recovery horizon
models.interpretation: The stock equation supplies its own result. It illustrates path-dependent recovery, not evidence of human learning dynamics or a novel hysteresis theorem.
models.counterexample: Zero decay, cheap instant replacement, or transferable practice on other activities can preserve fallback without duplicating the automated task.

models.name: Delegation can manufacture or destroy its own alternative
models.interpretation: The derivative changes sign when alpha*rho*s*delta exceeds beta*b. These linear stock-flow assumptions manufacture a clean threshold; no real-world threshold or novelty is established. The same deployment can be self-limiting or self-necessitating depending on collective reinvestment.
models.counterexample: If displaced practice was not useful or gains transfer without reserve expenditure, the model overstates the need for reinvestment.
